design.decision: one generated lightweight distribution repository per registered semantic dataset; dataset identity, TF schema version, immutable release identity, and upstream source state remain distinct

tdd.adversarial_regression_red_result: 3 failed, 186 passed, 1 skipped; failures were loadability-before-visibility, forbidden payload leakage, and corrupted-current-tree replay
tdd.validator_side_effect_red_result: 5 failed because Text-Fabric validation mutated the directory being digested; fixed by validating an isolated copy

review.resolution: publisher now rejects structurally complete but unloadable TF, rejects raw/build/research payload directories, verifies current visible release integrity before replay, and performs TF load validation on an isolated copy so validation cannot alter publishable bytes

benchmark.method: pinned Agora GitStore via loopback git daemon with /proc/net/dev RX+TX byte deltas
benchmark.result: equivalent TF payloads load at exact immutable revisions; the generated minimal repository sharply reduces cold Git transfer and metadata/tree coupling while warm/no-change cost remains small

result: PH0 establishes and tests a fail-closed local distribution contract with immutable release ledger, registered semantic dataset identity, load-before-visibility validation, current-tree tamper detection, minimal repository boundary, and measured compatibility with Agora's existing repository acquisition model. External repository mutation remains deferred to a separately reviewed phase.
